text:
acme-support: hitting a 413 on /v1/rerank when we send ~120 docs, error message is just 'payload too large' — no field indicated, confuses us
maya: sorry about that — can you paste a minimal curl or payload? also which model + endpoint exactly?
acme-support: using POST /v1/rerank model: rwd-base-ranker v1. payload includes query and an array 'documents' with full text. here's a redacted curl we tried:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"How do I reset password?","documents":["<doc1 long...>","<doc2 long...>","... up to 120 items ..."]}'
```
acme-support: we trimmed docs sizes and hit the limit either when query+docs combined tokens > ~75k chars? Not sure
sam: curious — we cap total request payload for rerank to avoid costly per-request work. 413 means HTTP body over our nginx limit or our internal limit. can you share approx total bytes or characters?
acme-support: measured ~950KB when uncompressed. we think many docs are long (10-30KB each)
maya: thanks. two asks: 1) can you repro with a smaller sample so we can reproduce? 2) do you need guidance on client-side chunking/snippet extraction?
acme-support: i can send a 3-doc repro. but ideally API would return more actionable message like 'documents total size exceeds X bytes'
eli: tagging eng-ml to triage error messaging and limits: @sam any chance the 413 text can include which field exceeded (documents vs. query) and the size limit?
sam: good point — current path returns 413 upstream with generic body. we should map to a friendlier error: code RERANK_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, message with max bytes and which array caused it. filing internal task.
maya: for now adv to customer: prefer sending either: 1) top-K candidate docs (use embeddings to pre-filter) or 2) send passages/snippets per doc instead of full doc bodies. also suggest compressing or trimming metadata fields.
acme-support: ok we'll try that. can you provide a short example of chunking?
maya: yes — suggestion: pre-split docs into passages ~512 tokens and rerank on those. sample pseudocode:
```
# pseudo
passages = []
for doc in docs:
  passages += split_into_windows(doc, window=400, stride=50)
candidates = select_topN(passages, N=200)
POST /v1/rerank {"query": q, "documents": candidates}
```
eli: also note per-request token limit differs by model; for rwd-base-ranker v1 we currently enforce ~200k token-equivalent across query+documents; we'll add explicit docs.
acme-support: thanks. we'll try snippet approach and report back. do you want our repro payload privately?
maya: yes please DM it or upload to the support ticket with request-id header. also include X-Request-ID if available from your client — that helps tracing.
acme-support: sending now, includes curl and compressed size. thanks! :thumbsup:
support-bot: New support ticket #S-63521 created and assigned to support/eng-ml. Priority: P2
sam: assigned to me for initial triage. i'll attempt repro with their payload and add a clear error mapping if confirmed.
maya: follow-up: i added a short KB note summarizing workaround (snippet+pre-filter) and asked docs to list the current byte/token ceilings. cc @eli
acme-support: confirmed workaround reduced payload to 45KB and request succeeded. thanks for the quick guidance.
eli: great. internal follow-ups: (1) add RERANK_PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE error with details, (2) update docs with per-model request token/byte ceilings + recommended chunking snippet, (3) consider server-side suggestion header like 'X-Rerank-Limit: 200000 bytes' in 413 responses.
sam: will open PR for error mapping and add an instrument to log which field triggered the limit.
maya: closing loop with customer in support ticket and will watch for doc PR.
acme-support: appreciate it, closing from our side once docs update.
